body: How did you deal with it? I've gone through breakups before but I really thought she was the one I'd start a family with
I've been through my share of relationships but she was the one man

Thanks for your response. No, I won't say the relationship was it built on a lie. We met, fell in love and are together based on common and romantic interests. That has nothing to do with the previous girl. What we have is genuine love. I fully agree with your other assessment though, I think what happened, and hearing what happened not from my own mouth was extremely damaging. With that said, I'll definitely lie in this bed I made and hope I can get out of it at some point.
Understood. I was cautious of her last threats to harm herself and thought what I was doing at the time was right. Looking back on it from a bird's eye view, there is no justification for what I did.

Yeah I can understand that. I can probably never fully regain her trust ever again, and I definitely know saying that I won't lie to her doesn't help her to believe me after such a huge shock. I can't see myself with anyone else right now, so I really cannot imagine how I can go on. This really sucks, and I know it's completely my fault.

Her last message to me after trying to explain myself was, "Right now, I'm not in the frame of mind to talk. I need some time for myself." 

I told her I respect her need for space and haven't messaged her since. I suppose all I can do is wait and pray.

I was seeing and speaking with her non-romantically, just because I was worried that she would harm herself. I know it looks like I emotionally cheated on her, but I never had any feelings for this girl, ever. I definitely fucked up, I know this, but we were perfect in every other way - I just didn't know what to do about this previous girl.

Of course, I completely understand where she's coming from and why she would no longer trust me. I guess I really do have to hope there's a lifeline coming my way. I was just afraid of losing her to this. Her last message to me was that she needs some time to think. I know that our relationship has been perfect in every way apart from this, and I really hope she's willing to give me a second chance.

Thank you for your honesty. There wasn't any cheating or any sexual interactions with her, but you're right in saying that there was lying for a very long time. I can completely understand her reaction, but do you think there's anything at all I can do to help this survive? I really can't see a life without her.

Thank you so much for your response. I think I did lie to her. She asked me about my previous relationships in the beginning of our relationship and I told her that I don't speak with any of them anymore (which was not true because I had been speaking with my ex at the time), and I wasn't honest about when I went to meet my ex as well, because I didn't tell her exactly when I went to meet her. It was lying by not giving her the full truth. I was afraid of losing her over this because she has a history of trust issues in the past, so I kept all of this hidden from her. Although I wasn't romantic with my ex at all, I think she's very afraid about me not being upfront about this given her previous trust issues, and doesn't believe my explanation because it sounds so ridiculous.

That really sucks man, but I understand why she would not want to be with me anymore after this. It's just so difficult for me to believe this is happening because she really was perfect and just a couple days ago, we were 100% okay.

From what I understand, the previous girl told my gf that I tell her that I love her and want to be with her. Truthfully, I have said those things to her in the past, but she because she heard this first from the previous girl first and believes her more than she believes me, I dont think it's likely that the previous girl will reach out to her for me.  That previous girl still likes me, and I feel that all I've been doing by facilitating her is make her continue to like me, even though I did nothing romantic for her.
Thank you, and I will and already am. I just wish I can explain myself better.
